info.title: Quicc POS channel API
info.description: main's ports for every sales channel (main 3.0). A channel — the web storefront, the call center, a counter POS terminal, a vendor feed — is an adapter: it holds no business rules and asks main for the menu, prices, store status, orders and tracking. Each channel belongs to one store and authenticates with its own bearer key (qch_…, issued in main's admin UI). Every error is {error, code}; branch on code.

post.summary: A call-center operator signs in (12 hours)
post.description: Operators are created by the admin, each allowed some stores. The token then works on /channel/v1 as `Authorization: Bearer qops_…` with the store worked on as `X-Location-ID` (one of `locations`): it acts as that store's built-in Call center channel, and orders record the operator. It stops working after 12 hours or at sign-out. Failed sign-ins are throttled per username (429).
Bearer the sign-in. 204 also when it was already signed out.

get.summary: Who am I: the channel behind this key and its store
The channel's menu: its view of the store's menu bank
get.description: Every item is anchored to bank item ids (anchor.item_ids) — an order names those. Prices are final for this channel (the view's rule and overrides applied), in cents. The ETag is the menu version; send it back as If-None-Match to get a 304 while nothing changed. Needs the menu permission.

304.description: Not changed since the ETag sent

get.summary: The menu's version — poll this, refetch the menu when it moves

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: A version you hold; the answer says whether the menu changed after it

400.description: since is not a version number

get.summary: What this channel prices with: settings, deals and item facts (everything but the menu)
get.description: For instant previews in the client: run the same engine (main's frontend/src/lib/pricing/engine.ts) over /channel/v1/menu (same menu_version) and this. POST /channel/v1/quote stays the authority. Needs the quote permission.

post.description: Checked against the store's status (open now, or promised_at one of /store/times), re-priced (cart problems → 422 cart_invalid with issues; expected_total_cents different from main's → 409 price_changed: refresh), a delivery address the store reaches (the website must be inside the area; the call center and counter may send any), paid through the payment port (cash = due at the store / to the driver; card only where a card processor is connected). Idempotent: the same client_order_id answers 200 with the same order. Needs the orders permission and the payment method in the channel's payments. Durable (DURABILITY-PLAN.md): main records the order under its client_order_id before any money moves and finishes the work even if the caller hangs up; the same client_order_id with a different order → 409 key_reused; arriving after expires_at → 409 expired (never charged); the store's Pi offline ~30 s → 409 kitchen_offline (a scheduled order due ≥ 1 h ahead is still taken); still at work after ~25 s → 202 {state: pending}: ask GET /channel/v1/orders/by-key/{client_order_id}. verification_required isn't final: send the same order again with payment.verification_token.

402.description: payment_declined, or verification_required (verify the buyer, then send verification_token)

409.description: store_paused, store_closed, bad_time, price_changed, payment_unavailable; key_reused (the same client_order_id with a different order), expired (after expires_at: never charged), voided (the card hold was released before the order was saved), kitchen_offline (the store's Pi is offline), payment_canceled

422.description: cart_invalid (issues), outside_area, address_unknown; card_not_found (a saved card no longer on the account)

503.description: try_again (an address lookup or main is unavailable)

parameters.name: X-Customer-Session
parameters.description: Signed-in website customer: the order joins their account; needed for payment.card_id / save_card

get.summary: An order's placement by its client_order_id
get.description: What happened to a POST /orders: pending, placed (with the order), refused / expired / voided (with the error). 404 unknown_key: main never got it — send the same order again.

get.summary: One of this channel's orders: where it is
get.description: Needs the track permission. driver is the first name only, while the order is out (or delivered).

get.summary: This channel's orders as they change (Server-Sent Events)
get.description: Each change of one of this channel's orders is an event `id: <n>` / `event: order.status` / data = OrderEvent (JSON). A fresh stream starts now; reconnect with the Last-Event-ID header (or ?last_event_id=) to get what you missed, within 24 hours — an id no longer kept gets one `event: reset` (re-read your orders), then the live stream. Keepalive comments every 15 s. Needs the track permission. Not gzipped.
The order's track_token makes the link. Status, kitchen number, ready-by and the driver's first name — no customer details, no items. 120 a minute per IP.

post.description: Prices against this channel's menu, settings and deals right now. errors[] says what stops the cart being ordered as it is (sold out, option rules, a deal or code that doesn't apply, an order type that's off, the delivery minimum); the totals are still computed. Needs the quote permission.

get.summary: The store's status: open, paused or closed, order types and ready-time estimates, today's hours, sold-out items
get.description: accepting = ASAP orders are taken now. When it is false, next_open_at says when they are again (null = unknown: paused until the store unpauses, or open with every order type off). Brygid-style vendor orders are not affected by a pause. kitchen_offline = the store's kitchen (its Pi) can't get an order right now: say so before checkout (ASAP orders are refused).

get.summary: Times an order can be promised for on a date
get.description: Every 15 minutes: the kitchen needs the type's ETA after the later of opening, now and the pause's end, and the time must fall before closing. Empty while paused until further notice. The date is the store's local date, today up to scheduling.days_ahead.

400.description: Bad type or a date outside the window

409.description: That order type is off (type_off) or the store takes ASAP orders only (asap_only)

post.summary: Does the store deliver to this address?
post.description: Straight-line distance from the store vs its delivery radius (the rule the store's tablet uses). result: inside (deliverable), outside, check (several places match — show candidates and check the picked one), not_found, no_store_location, delivery_off. The address is not stored or logged. Needs the quote permission. 30 checks a minute per channel.

400.description: No street line, or neither zip nor city

503.description: The address lookup is down; try again (try_again)

get.summary: The store's website: published look + texts and hosts
get.description: ETag = a hash of the answer; send If-None-Match to get a 304 while nothing changed. The storefront polls this (and /menu/version) to know when to re-render. With ?preview=<token> (the Website page's private link) it answers with the open draft instead (preview: true); a stale token is 403 bad_preview.

parameters.name: preview
parameters.description: The store's preview token: answer with the draft

304.description: Not changed since the ETag you sent

404.description: Not one of this store's images

channelKey.description: The channel's key: Authorization: Bearer qch_… — or an operator's sign-in (Bearer qops_… from /channel/v1/operator/login) with X-Location-ID: the store; without it 400 location_required, a store the operator may not work on 403 location_not_allowed. — or the storefront's platform key (Bearer qpk_…, one per storefront server) with X-Site-Host: the host it is serving; the store behind a verified host answers as its built-in web channel. Without the header 400 host_required; a host no store is served on (or not verified yet) 404 unknown_site. Website customers: X-Customer-Session: qcs_… (from POST /channel/v1/account/verify, 90 days, renewed on use) on /account/* and POST /orders — 401 sign_in without it where required, 401 session_invalid when bad or expired; only the store's web channel takes it (403 otherwise). The storefront forwards the customer's IP as X-Customer-IP (sign-in limits).

Unauthorized.description: Missing, unknown or revoked channel key

Forbidden.description: This channel's permissions don't allow it

Unavailable.description: main can't check the key right now (try_again)

code.description: Stable, for programs (unauthorized, forbidden, not_found, bad_request, …)

payments.description: Payment methods an order through this channel may use

price_cents.description: Price when the item has no size (or no size price)

prices.description: Price on an item of each size

is_default.description: Comes on the item unless removed

portions.description: Options may go on a half (left / right) or the whole

id.description: The view item's id (a bank item id, or a view entry's for a merged / added item)

price_cents.description: Price when it has no sizes

modifier_group_ids.description: The item's modifier groups, in order (each is in the menu's modifier_groups)

modifier_groups.description: Every modifier group the menu's items use, once

close.description: HH:MM; at or before open = past midnight

hours_set.description: false = no hours set: always open

week.description: Today and the next six days (special days applied), for an hours card

kitchen_offline.description: The store's Pi (its kitchen) can't get an order now: no live connection to main for ~30 s, or its printer reports stopped. ASAP orders are refused with 409 kitchen_offline; orders scheduled at least 1 h ahead are still taken. Always false for a store with no Pi set up.

choice_id.description: A combined item: the choice's item_id
A combined item: the choice's item_id

deal_id.description: A bundle deal; then picks fill its steps

regular_cents.description: A bundle: its picks' own price

code.description: empty, unknown_item, unknown_size, unknown_option, option_rules, sold_out, deal_ended, deal_unavailable, deal_slot, code_invalid, code_minimum, code_first_order, code_not_combinable, type_off, bad_type, delivery_minimum

token.description: The card processor's one-time token (card): Square Web Payments SDK tokenize() — card data never reaches main

verification_token.description: Square verifyBuyer()'s token when the bank asks for 3-D Secure (402 verification_required)

card_id.description: A saved card of the signed-in customer (instead of token)

save_card.description: Keep this card for next time (signed-in customers; an unticked box at checkout)

promised_at.description: null = as soon as possible; else one of /store/times

expected_total_cents.description: The total the channel showed; refused if main's differs

expires_at.description: The channel's deadline: arriving later, the order is refused (expired) and never charged. The storefront sends it; optional.

taken_by.description: The operator who took it (operator sign-ins)

primary_host.description: The host links should use ("" = none yet)

hosts.description: Every verified host the store is served on

preview.description: These are the open draft's settings (asked with ?preview=)

email.description: The store's contact email (receipt replies; the privacy page). "" = none

methods.description: What an order through this channel may be paid with

app_id.description: Square application id for the Web Payments SDK

location_id.description: The store's Square location id for the Web Payments SDK

card.description: How to take a card: null when the store has no card processor connected (card orders then go to the test card on dev / staging, or are refused with 409 payment_unavailable)

hold_hours.description: A card is authorized at checkout and captured later (the driver's clock-out, Close batch, or after this many hours)

AddressRequest.description: line1 and a zip or city; the account's first address is its default; up to 20

call_after_s.description: Offer 'Call me instead' after this many seconds

joined_orders.description: Past guest web orders with this phone now in the account

lines.description: The past order's lines still on the menu

dropped.description: Items that can't be ordered any more

quote.description: The lines priced today (null when nothing is left)

SiteSettings.description: The look and texts from Store › Website ({} until published). Every field is optional: missing = the storefront's default.

texts.description: The store's words ("" = the storefront's own); *_es = the Spanish text

blocks.description: The home page's blocks in order, each on or off (missing = the default set)

picks.description: "From the menu": menu item ids, in order

announcement.description: One line on top of every page, optionally only between two store-local dates (inclusive)

miso_pages.description: Miso on cart, checkout, sign-in and the empty pages (missing = on)

privacy.description: The privacy policy ("" = the default text)

OrderPlacement.description: A placement: pending (main is at work; with error when it waits for the caller — verification_required / try_again), placed (order), refused / expired / voided (error).
